title: web/src/tools/review-diff.test.ts:227 expected diff omits removed log_note

note: no usage window in the answer

question: Q-001
reason: The spec's ADDED requirement states surfaceDiff returns `removed` for a tool only in `approved`, sorted by name. In the test, LOG is log_note and FD is find_vendor (spread of FIND), so surfaceDiff(S(LOG), S(FD)) must contain an added find_vendor and a removed log_note. The D2 test in the same file (line 121-131) asserts the removed log_note item in the identical situation, and test-plan.md line 3 says D9 was not run on the prototype, which explains the omission. The clarifier suggestion adds exactly the missing item in sorted position, so I accepted it. review.ts is still a stub, so no implementation claim was needed.

checked.claim: The requirement says a tool present only in the approved surface is reported as removed.
LOG is the tool log_note, so S(LOG) contains only log_note.
FD spreads FIND, whose name is find_vendor, so S(FD) contains only find_vendor and log_note is only in the approved side.
The failing assertion compares the diff of S(LOG) to S(FD) against an array holding only the added find_vendor item.
The sibling D2 test expects the removed log_note item in the same situation, matching the suggested addition.

checked.quote: every row but K1 to K3, C2 and D9 on a prototype
checked.claim: D9 was derived rather than run, so its row's omission of the removal is not evidence that surfaceDiff should omit it.
